text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed bids will be received by the Honorable Christopher B. Burnham, Treasurer of the State of Connecticut, at 55 Elm Street, 7th Floor, Hartford, Connecticut, at 11:00 A.M., Hartford Time, on Tuesday, for the purchase of all (but not less than all) of the $150,000,000 State of Connecticut General Obligation Bonds, 1997 Series A (the Bonds'').

The Bonds will be dated March 1, 1997 and will bear interest payable semiannually on March 1 and September 1 in each year commencing September 1, 1997 and will mature on March 1 in the years 1998 through 1999 and 2004 through 2017, in the principal amounts as set forth in the Official Proposal for Bonds. The Bonds are subject to redemption prior to maturity. The Bonds will initially be offered in book-entry only form through the facilities of The
Depository Trust Company. Beneficial interests in the Bonds will be available in denominations of $5,000 or any integral multiple thereof.

Each bid must be for not less than par and may include a premium, plus accrued interest from March 1, 1997, the dated date of the Bonds, and otherwise conform to the requirements of the Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be awarded to the responsible bidder whose bid will produce the lowest true interest cost to the State as set forth in the Notice of Sale. All bids must be accompanied by a good faith check, in form described in the Notice of Sale, in an amount equal to $1,500,000.
The legal opinion of Bond Counsel to the State regarding the validity and Federal and State tax-exempt status of the Bonds will be attached to the Bonds.

The State has prepared a Preliminary Official Statement dated February 28, 1997 concerning the offering of the Bonds which has been deemed final as of its date by the State for purposes of SEC rule 15c2-12. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, Notice of Sale and Official Proposal for Bonds are available from the Office of the State Treasurer, Attention: David P. Warren, Assistant Treasurer, 55 Elm Street, Hartford, Connecticut 06106 or by calling (860) 702- 3137.
Treasurer of The State of Connecticut
